whyMatters.en: Detroit duo that reduced rock to guitar, drums, and vocal—Elephant (2003, Toe Rag/Liam Watson) and Seven Nation Army’s octave-pedal riff became early-2000s garage-revival proof without bass.
whyMatters.zh: 底特律双人组：把摇滚压成吉他、鼓、人声——Elephant（2003，Toe Rag/Liam Watson）与 Seven Nation Army 的八度效果器 riff 成为 2000 年代初无贝斯车库复兴证据。

essentialTracks.title: Fell in Love with a Girl

shortBio.en: Jack / Meg White Detroit duo; red-white-black minimalism, Toe Rag lo-fi, Seven Nation Army the global riff chant.
shortBio.zh: Jack / Meg White 底特律双人组；红白黑极简、Toe Rag lo-fi，Seven Nation Army 是全球 riff 口号。

body.en:
Formed 1997 in Detroit. Sympathy for the Record Industry releases and White Blood Cells (2001) kept recording raw—no bass, Meg’s floor-tom-heavy drums, Jack’s blues bends and fuzz.

Elephant (2003) hit mainstream via Seven Nation Army’s octave-pedal riff and Toe Rag’s vintage compression. Icky Thump (2007) added bagpipes and Nashville punch while keeping the two-piece rule.
body.zh:
1997 年于底特律组建。Sympathy for the Record Industry 发行与 White Blood Cells（2001）保持毛糙录音——无贝斯、Meg 的地鼓重击、Jack 的蓝调推弦与 fuzz。

Elephant（2003）借 Seven Nation Army 的八度效果器 riff 与 Toe Rag 复古压缩打进主流。Icky Thump（2007）加入风笛与纳什维尔冲击，仍守二人组规则。

title.zh: 车库减法作为主流论证

body.en:
The White Stripes prove early-2000s rock radio still answered to blues-garage subtraction—not only nu-metal density. Guitar, drums, vocal; no bass by design.

Seven Nation Army’s Whammy line is the technical fact: one guitarist simulates bass on a global chant.
body.zh:
The White Stripes 证明 2000 年代初摇滚电台仍回应蓝调车库减法——不只有 nu-metal 密度。吉他、鼓、人声；刻意无贝斯。

Seven Nation Army 的 Whammy 线是技术事实：一名吉他手在全球口号上模拟贝斯。

body.en:
Jack White handles all harmonic content—riffs, leads, piano overdubs. Meg White’s straight-ahead drum patterns anchor tempo without flash fills.

No lineup versions in the session sense: the brand is the two-person constraint from 1997 to 2011.
body.zh:
Jack White 承担全部和声内容——riff、主音、钢琴叠录。Meg White 的直鼓型定 tempo，无炫技 fill。

录音意义上无阵容版本：品牌就是 1997–2011 的双人限制。

title.en: Post-Strokes garage and arena riff export
title.zh: 后 Strokes 车库与体育场 riff 出口

body.en:
Alongside The Strokes, they reopened 2000s indie to raw guitar reduction. Seven Nation Army crossed into sports chants—riff as public-domain hook.

Arctic Monkeys and later UK indie cite the lo-fi duo proof against polished Britpop hangover.
body.zh:
与 The Strokes 并列，他们为 2000 年代 indie 重开毛糙吉他减法。Seven Nation Army 进入体育口号——riff 成为公共领域钩子。

Arctic Monkeys 与后来英国 indie 引用 lo-fi 双人组证据，对抛光 Britpop 余波。
